worldviews.name: Monarchist — The Throne
worldviews.core: Order, hierarchy, legitimate authority, institutions, duty, stability, continuity and noblesse oblige. Authority carries obligations as well as privileges.
worldviews.shadow: Authoritarianism, stagnation, bloodline over merit, romanticising an invented past, and treating obedience as virtue in itself.

worldviews.name: Anarchist — The Broken Chain
worldviews.core: No masters. Autonomy, mutual aid, voluntary association, direct action and scepticism towards coercive hierarchy.
worldviews.shadow: Naïveté about power, mob rule, destruction of useful institutions and the tyranny of structurelessness.

worldviews.name: Religious — The Covenant
worldviews.core: Faith, meaning, moral law, vows, mercy, sacred obligations and community. Gods are real and moral duties extend beyond immediate self-interest.
worldviews.shadow: Zealotry, theocracy, persecution, moral absolutism and divine justification for cruelty.

worldviews.name: Guildist — The Ledger
worldviews.core: Contracts, exchange, enterprise, property, incentives, trade, written obligations and civic prosperity.
worldviews.shadow: Believing everyone has a price, treating poverty as failure, commodifying relationships and allowing wealth to become political domination.

worldviews.name: Arcane Supremacist — The Ascendant
worldviews.core: Magical ability, knowledge and demonstrated capability constitute the truest hierarchy. Those who understand powers others cannot may therefore have a claim to lead.
worldviews.shadow: Rule by a gifted caste, contempt for lesser or non-magical people, eugenics-adjacent thinking, dangerous experimentation and assuming power proves fitness.

worldviews.name: Druidic — The Root
worldviews.core: Balance, cycles, ecology, limits, interdependence, the interests of the land and future generations. Humanity belongs within nature rather than above it.
worldviews.shadow: Eco-fascism, forced regression, treating people as disease, sacrificing individuals for abstract balance and cruelty justified as natural necessity.

worldviews.name: Illuminated / Mad — The Cracked Mirror
worldviews.core: John increasingly notices that reality behaves like a story, game, dream or simulation: patterns, repeated structures, dramatic conventions and impossible coincidences.
worldviews.shadow: Detachment from real suffering, treating people as fictional objects, cruelty as entertainment and 'nothing is real so nothing matters'.
